identity.name: EMAIL — Phishing Credential-Harvest Link (Proofpoint TAP + Microsoft 365)
identity.summary: The email_emitter emits a Proofpoint TAP messagesBlocked event carrying a credential-harvest URL plus a clicksPermitted event for one recipient, then proves the same phishing-link logic fires over the Microsoft 365 EmailEvents shape. Cortex XSIAM analyzes the email ingestion stream and raises a credential-phishing alert on the recipient mailbox, corroborated by the NGFW egress to the collector.
identity.description: Spearphishing-link credential harvest is the #1 initial-access vector: an inbound message carries a URL that lures the recipient to a credential-capture page (T1566.002), often paired with information-gathering pretexts (T1598). This card drives CortexSim's email_emitter to POST a Proofpoint TAP messagesBlocked event (threatsInfoMap classification=credphish, threatType=url) and a clicksPermitted event for ada.lovelace into the email log collector, then repeats the pattern in Microsoft 365 / Defender for Office 365 EmailEvents shape. Detection is pure email-log analytics in Cortex XSIAM: an XQL rule windows blocked + permitted-click events per recipient over the proofpoint_tap_raw dataset and alerts when a credential-phishing URL is delivered or clicked, with a parallel query proving the same resolves over msft_o365, and an NGFW EAL query confirming the outbound POST burst. A correlation rule fuses the email phishing signal with the recipient's endpoint/identity follow-on into a single account-compromise incident.

prerequisites.description: CortexSim email_emitter EAL plugin registered and an authorized email log collector endpoint reachable.
prerequisites.check_command: python3 -m scripts.eal_simulator.cli describe email_emitter | jq -e '.eal_targets | length > 0'

prerequisites.description: Cortex XSIAM ingesting the Proofpoint TAP (proofpoint_tap_raw) and Microsoft 365 (msft_o365) email datasets.

payload.code:
# Emit a phishing credential-link message (Proofpoint TAP then Microsoft 365 shape).
python3 -m scripts.eal_simulator.cli run /tmp/email-001.yml --live
python3 -m scripts.eal_simulator.cli run /tmp/email-001-m365.yml --live

expected_artifacts.description: A blocked inbound message and a permitted click for one recipient carrying a credential-harvest URL classified as credphish.
expected_artifacts.expected_value: classification = "credphish" and threatsInfoMap.threatType = "url" for one recipient

expected_artifacts.description: Outbound HTTPS POST burst from the scenario runner to the email log collector.

iocs.context: Sender domain of the credential-harvest phishing message emitted by email_emitter (_PATTERN_INDICATORS["phishing_link"].sender_domain). Appears in the Proofpoint TAP senderDomain / M365 SenderMailFromDomain field.
Credential-capture URL carried in the threatsInfoMap.threatUrl / M365 Url field of the synthetic phishing message.
Spoofed IT-helpdesk sender address of the credential-harvest lure (email_emitter phishing_link indicators). Pivot for the account-compromise incident.

biocs.name: EMAIL-001 Pre-Flight email_emitter Metadata Visible
biocs.description: Pre-flight: email_emitter metadata visible to operator. Confirms the EAL plugin is registered and exposes EMAIL targets before any events are emitted, so a null result means a harness fault rather than a detection miss.
biocs.logic:
dataset = proofpoint_tap_raw
| filter messageType in ("messagesBlocked", "messagesDelivered", "clicksPermitted") or _raw_log contains "email_emitter"
| comp count() as preflight_events by recipient
| filter preflight_events >= 0

xql_queries.name: EMAIL-001 Phishing Credential-Link Blocked + Permitted Click
xql_queries.query:
// [MODEL: dataset=proofpoint_tap_raw, content_id="ProofpointTAP"]
dataset = proofpoint_tap_raw
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter classification in ("credphish", "phish") and messageType in ("messagesBlocked", "clicksPermitted")
| comp count() as phish_events, values(messageType) as event_kinds, values(threatUrl) as urls by recipient, sender
| filter phish_events >= 1
| fields recipient, sender, phish_events, event_kinds, urls

xql_queries.name: EMAIL-001 Phishing Link Microsoft 365 EmailEvents Shape
xql_queries.query:
dataset = msft_o365
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter RecordType = "EmailEvents" and ThreatTypes contains "Phish" and UrlCount >= 1
| comp count() as phish_events, values(Url) as urls by RecipientEmailAddress, SenderFromAddress
| filter phish_events >= 1
| fields RecipientEmailAddress, SenderFromAddress, phish_events, urls

xql_queries.name: EMAIL-001 NGFW Outbound POST Burst To Email Collector
xql_queries.query:
dataset = panw_ngfw_traffic_raw
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter app in ("web-browsing", "ssl") and dst_port = 443
| filter uri_path contains "/email/events" or url contains "/email/events"
| comp count() as post_count, sum(bytes_sent) as bytes_out by src_ip, dst_host
| filter post_count >= 1
| fields src_ip, dst_host, post_count, bytes_out

correlation_rules.name: Phishing Credential-Link Account Compromise — Email to Endpoint Stitch
correlation_rules.logic: XQL(EMAIL-001 Phishing Credential-Link Blocked + Permitted Click) OR XQL(EMAIL-001 Phishing Link Microsoft 365 EmailEvents Shape) FOLLOWED_BY xdr_data endpoint process for the same recipient within 1h

analytics_modules: Cortex XSIAM Email Analytics — Credential-phishing URL delivered/clicked per recipient
Cortex XSIAM Correlation — Email phishing to endpoint follow-on stitch

products.evidence_query: dataset = proofpoint_tap_raw | filter classification in ("credphish", "phish") | comp count() by recipient | filter _count >= 1
Correlation CR-EMAIL-0001 stitches the email phishing-link signal to the recipient's endpoint follow-on into one account-compromise incident.

use_cases.name: Phishing Credential-Link Detection
use_cases.description: Detect a credential-harvest phishing URL delivered to or clicked by a recipient across both Proofpoint TAP and Microsoft 365 email log shapes, stitched to the endpoint follow-on.

test_cases.objective: A blocked phishing message plus a permitted click for one recipient raises a credential-phishing alert.
preconditions: Cortex XSIAM ingesting proofpoint_tap_raw and msft_o365 datasets.
email_emitter authorized against the lab collector.
steps: Observe the credential-phishing alert per recipient in the Cortex console.
success_criteria: XQL `EMAIL-001 Phishing Credential-Link Blocked + Permitted Click` returns >= 1 row.
XQL `EMAIL-001 Phishing Link Microsoft 365 EmailEvents Shape` returns >= 1 row.
NGFW POST-burst query corroborates the collector egress.

test_cases.objective: The email phishing signal stitches to the recipient endpoint follow-on.
success_criteria: Correlation `CR-EMAIL-0001` groups the email phishing-link signal with the recipient endpoint follow-on under one incident.

preventive_controls: Rewrite and detonate inbound URLs (time-of-click protection) before delivery.
Enforce phishing-resistant MFA so a harvested password is insufficient.
Strip or quarantine messages from newly-registered or look-alike sender domains.
detection_engineering: Window blocked + permitted-click events per recipient over the Proofpoint TAP dataset and alert on credential-phishing classifications.
Normalize Proofpoint TAP and Microsoft 365 EmailEvents into one email schema so the rule fires regardless of provider.
Stitch the email phishing signal to the recipient's endpoint/identity follow-on.
